mapper.sql: id, original_name, storage_path, size, mime, uploader_id, visibility, owner_dept_id, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_file (original_name, storage_path, size, mime, uploader_id, visibility, owner_dept_id) VALUES (#{originalName}, #{storagePath}, #{size}, #{mime}, #{uploaderId}, #{visibility}, #{ownerDeptId})
mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.original_name, f.storage_path, f.size, f.mime, f.uploader_id, f.visibility, f.owner_dept_id, f.created_at, u.username AS uploader_name FROM sys_file f LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = f.uploader_id WHERE f.id = #{id}

SELECT f.id, f.original_name, f.storage_path, f.size, f.mime, f.uploader_id, f.visibility, f.owner_dept_id, f.created_at, u.username AS uploader_name FROM sys_file f LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = f.uploader_id WHERE f.uploader_id = #{uploaderId} ORDER BY f.id DESC

SELECT f.id, f.original_name, f.storage_path, f.size, f.mime, f.uploader_id, f.visibility, f.owner_dept_id, f.created_at, u.username AS uploader_name FROM sys_file f LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = f.uploader_id ORDER BY f.id DESC
